cost: M rows,F files,U URL bytes,S disk bytes: naming O(F²+U), directory walk O(entries), hash O(S) and 1 MiB buffer; merge O(M²F) expected hashing. Long path_name remove(0) can be quadratic.
description: Dispatch selects plan/verify/merge/bib. load filters before uniqueness/name checks. plan writes provenance, migrates matching-size files, queues remaining by host, deletes old curl configs then writes new. check orders metadata/size, MD5, SHA1, magic. merge resolves slug precedence, subsets then partial ownership.
forward: Dispatch selects plan/verify/merge/bib. load filters before uniqueness/name checks. plan writes provenance, migrates matching-size files, queues remaining by host, deletes old curl configs then writes new. check orders metadata/size, MD5, SHA1, magic. merge resolves slug precedence, subsets then partial ownership.
inverse: Rejected load excludes plan writes. plan never invokes curl. check size failure cannot reach successful digest/magic stages.
Queue pairs admit many manifests with different metadata/already-present/skipped files. Merge output admits arbitrary dropped duplicate/subset rows; no unique inverse.
limitations: Partial syntax and finite fixtures, not universal semantic proof.
Value full workflow, arbitrary manifests and external IO failures are not exercised.
state: Bounded JSONL with confined safe slugs/names and representable u64 sums. Arbitrary slug confinement is not validated by production. Unknown size accepts any existing length; queue omission is not content verification. Effects nontransactional.
